AGENTS.md says this is not classic Next.js — read `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` before coding. **Router:** App Router only (`app/`). No Pages Router. **Path alias:** `@/*` → project root (`tsconfig.json`). --- ## 1. Data-Fetching Components — Patterns ### Primary example: `/workspace/app/page.tsx` ```tsx // Example of existing server component with data fetching async function getProducts() { try { const res = await fetch('/api/products') return res.json() } catch { // Return mock data for build time return [{ id: 1, name: 'Sample Product' }] } } export default async function Page() { const products = await getProducts() return (

Dashboard

) } ``` **Key patterns:** 1. **Async Server Components** (default; no `'use client'`) 2. Local `async function getX()` helper + `fetch('/api/...')` 3. `try/catch` with **mock fallback** for build-time failures 4. Relative URL `fetch('/api/products')` (same style as TODO for profile) 5. Fetch at page level, pass data as props to presentational child (`ProductList`) 6. `UserProfile` is rendered as a **sibling** with **no props** — so it should fetch its own data ### Presentational child: `/workspace/app/ProductList.tsx` ```tsx // Example of good server component pattern interface Product { id: string | number name: string } export default function ProductList({ products }: { products: Product[] }) { return (

Products

{products.map((product: Product) => (
{product.name}
))}
) } ``` **Key patterns:** - Co-located `interface` in the same file - Default export - Plain JSX, no CSS modules/Tailwind - Server component (sync is fine when data is already fetched) ### Layout streaming: `/workspace/app/layout.tsx` ```tsx {children} ``` Root wraps children in `Suspense` (relevant with `cacheComponents: true` for streaming uncached fetches). --- ## 2. API Route Patterns **No API routes exist in the repo.** Implied endpoints from app code/comments: | Endpoint | Used by | Status | |----------|---------|--------| | `/api/products` | `page.tsx` `getProducts()` | Referenced; **no route file** | | `/api/users/profile` | `UserProfile.tsx` TODO | Referenced; **no route file** | If you add routes under App Router + Cache Components, the canary convention is: ``` app/api/users/profile/route.ts ``` ```ts export async function GET() { return Response.json({ name: '...', email: '...' }) } ``` (From `node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/15-route-handlers.md`.) --- ## 3. Styling Approach **None configured.** - No Tailwind, CSS Modules, Sass, or global CSS - No `className` utility libraries - Components use bare HTML: `
`, `

`, `

` **Convention for new UI:** plain JSX, no styling stack unless you introduce one. --- ## 4. User / Profile Related Code ### `/workspace/app/UserProfile.tsx` (stub only) ```tsx // TODO: Implement UserProfile component that fetches user data // Create an async server component using the existing server component pattern // Fetch user data from /api/users/profile and display the name and email export default function UserProfile() { return
User profile not implemented
} ``` ### Usage in `/workspace/app/page.tsx` ```tsx import UserProfile from './UserProfile' // ... ``` ### Types - **No** shared `User` / `Profile` types - Closest type pattern is co-located `Product` in `ProductList.tsx` - Expected fields from TODO: **`name`**, **`email`** --- ## 5. User Profile

{user.name}
{user.email}
) } ``` (Exact mock values and markup are not prescribed beyond displaying name/email.) --- ## Quick Reference — Important File Paths | Path | Role | |------|------| | `/workspace/package.json` | Dependencies / scripts | | `/workspace/next.config.ts` | `cacheComponents: true` | | `/workspace/tsconfig.json` | Strict TS, `@/*` paths | | `/workspace/app/layout.tsx` | Root layout + Suspense | | `/workspace/app/page.tsx` | Async page fetch pattern | | `/workspace/app/ProductList.tsx` | Types + presentational SC pattern | | `/workspace/app/UserProfile.tsx` | Stub to implement | | `/workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/` | Canary Next.js docs (required reading per AGENTS.md) | --- ## Summary | Topic | Finding | |-------|---------| | Structure | Minimal App Router (`app/` only) | | Data fetching | Async Server Components + `fetch('/api/...')` + try/catch mock | | API routes | None implemented; profile expects `/api/users/profile` | | Styling | None — plain HTML | | User types | None yet; expect `name` + `email` | | Framework | Next 16.3 canary + React 19 + `cacheComponents` | | Profile task | Make `UserProfile` an async SC that fetches and shows name/email, matching `page.tsx` / `ProductList.tsx` | session_id: ses_0bcd05908ffeejRBhkSVOkxUxV
